messages:
julia: FYI customer AcmePay on dedicated-prod-us-west reporting intermittent 503s + high tail latency since ~09:10 UTC. They say it started after a batch of long-context queries. I see a spike in KV evictions and throttle events in the tenant metrics. Attaching quick repro and logs below.

omar: Thanks — can you paste 2 request_ids and the route/model they hit? also customer tier and whether they're on reserved capacity.

julia: request_ids: r-3f9a2b, r-3f9a8c. Route: /v1/chat.generate model: redwood-13b-ctx64k-dedicated. Tenant: acmepay-tenant-42, reserved dedicated pool (prod-us-west-2, 4 nodes).

lee: Looking at runtime metrics: KV cache eviction rate jumped ~6x at 09:09. kernel memfrag counter also increasing. Could be combined long-context broadcast + KV table fragmentation.

maria: Customer confirmed they sent a handful of extremely long chats (40–55k tokens) concurrently. That will blow up per-token KV footprint.

julia: Logs (trimmed):
```
[09:08:54] tenant=acmepay-42 req=r-3f9a2b status=200 latency=1.2s kv.cache.size=512MB kv.evictions=2
[09:09:12] tenant=acmepay-42 req=r-3f9a8c status=503 latency=0.2s reason=throttled kv.evictions=120
[09:09:15] tenant=acmepay-42 req=r-3f9a8f status=429 latency=0.05s reason=kv-pressure
```

omar: 503 then 429 indicates we hit the throttle policy after eviction flood. Can you share autoscaler events for that pool around 09:00–09:20?

julia: autoscale-bot: pool=dedicated-prod-us-west-2 nodes=4 -> 4 at 09:05 (no scale up) policy=min_nodes=4 max_nodes=8 cooldown=5m.

lee: Ah — cooldown prevented immediate scale up despite sustained queueing. Also node-level memory fragmented so adding a node wouldn't recover KV immediately; existing nodes had high slab fragmentation.

kevin: Two-prong mitigation: 1) temporarily bump pool min_nodes to 6 to add headroom, 2) lower KV eviction aggressiveness for this tenant (raise reserve) so their long-context requests degrade slower. I'll coordinate rollback after stability.

omar: Customer-impact steps to communicate to AcmePay?

julia: Told them we're adding capacity and tuning eviction thresholds, ETA 10–15m. Asked them to pause new long-context batch jobs for 30m. They acknowledged. :thumbsup:

autoscale-bot: executed: scaled pool dedicated-prod-us-west-2 min_nodes 4->6 by kevin at 09:25 UTC

lee: After scale and tweak we saw evictions drop and 503/429 stopped within ~4m. Memory fragmentation slowly recovered over a GC-like compaction window.

maria: For long-term: recommend per-tenant rate limits on long-context route OR prefix-aware KV caps + async fallback to shorter context model. Also add autoscaler policy to allow emergency fast-add when eviction_rate > X.

kevin: Filed SUPPORT-1428 to track postmortem & config changes. Will also surface a runbook for similar noisy-tenant KV blasts.

omar: Thanks team. Julia, can you add the customer comms snippet to the ticket and mark as 'mitigated' once AcmePay confirms?

julia: done, ticket updated with repro steps, logs, and the temporary config diffs. Customer said errors stopped and they're testing. Closing provisional.

lee: follow-up note: add metric alert for kv.evictions per-tenant crossing 50/min with a playbook to bypass cooldown for 10m.

maria: Also adding an eval to check quality of fallback shorter-context model for AcmePay's prompt patterns.

kevin: I'll schedule a short retro tomorrow. Thanks everyone. :pray:
